objective: Implement neutral staff roster, break, assignment, handover, escort-continuity and on-call latency contracts using the accepted UTC Calendar; keep role and clinical policy outside the scheduler core.
steps: Add behavior-first tests for roster coverage, break exclusions, overlap rejection, atomic two-person handover, contiguous escort retention, on-call latency/overflow, and non-interruptible procedure claims.

Implement neutral StaffId/BookingId, UTC calendar roster and break data, checked interval assignment, overlapping handover for distinct staff, and same-staff escort continuation over adjacent intervals.
Require handover reservation to validate both incoming windows before mutation; reject double-booking without partial assignments.
Compute call-in availability as requested time plus configured latency using checked arithmetic; do not make on-call staff immediately available or encode clinical roles.
Run focused staffing contract tests, core clippy and formatting; record exact source/input/output hashes.

verification.oracle: Roster/break, no-double-booking, handover, escort, call-in, and non-interruptible cases pass with atomic state on rejection.
CareOps core targets pass clippy with warnings denied.

acceptance: Staff availability requires roster coverage and excludes break intervals; every staff identity is booked at most once at an instant.
Handover permits distinct outgoing/incoming staff to overlap only for the declared same booking and validates all incoming windows atomically.
Escort continuity preserves one staff identity across adjacent escort intervals and blocks concurrent assignments.
Call-in latency is explicit, checked and never assumed zero.
Non-interruptible active procedure claims cannot be suspended or released by urgency; no clinical role, priority or staffing policy is added.
No ED schema/default, Kairos source/pin, production dependency or checkpoint behavior changes.
stop_conditions: Calendar unit or interval contract changes
